如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    那个李向阳三步并作两步，走到杨云帆前面，冷嘲热讽道：“是不是你这个臭小子拿了什么不干净的食物给檀香吃？看你穿的邋里邋遢的，吃的东西说不定有什么病毒。吃了不干净的东西，当然会肚子痛。”
李向阳本以为杨云帆看起来土包子一个，容易欺负的很，谁知道他完全想错了。
他刚说完，杨云帆就噌的一下站起来。
“你说什么？你这个四眼田鸡，说话归说话，把你的狗爪子缩回去！”杨云帆身材高大，一米八以上，李向阳长得干瘦干瘦的，就跟瘾君子一样。杨云帆一站起来，他就有点虚了。
“我，我不跟你一般见识！”
李向阳色厉内荏的看了杨云帆一眼，而后看向陆檀香，转移话题道：“檀香，让我看看你的肚子吧，我可是湘潭大学医学系的。”
一边说着，那个李向阳一边小心翼翼的绕过杨云帆，来到陆檀香身边，作势要把手伸到陆檀香的肚子上面去。
“呵呵，你这四眼田鸡还真有意思。给你条绳子，你就会顺着杆子爬。”
杨云帆一看他这个样子，就知道他要趁机吃豆腐，丝毫不给他留面子，直言讽刺道：“不过，我劝你还是不要打她的主意好。我观你四肢乏力，眼袋发青，额头更是出现莫名竖纹，估计肾虚的很。我猜你每天五点钟，就要肚子痛，起来拉肚子吧？”
“你，你怎么知道的？”李向阳一听这话，脸色瞬间大变。
这么秘密的事情，这个土包子怎么知道的？这事情，他可是谁都没有告诉。年纪轻轻就肾虚，这种丢人的事情，他才不会说出去。
“我怎么知道的？”
杨云帆嗤笑一声，道：“你不知道自己脸色青暗无光，额头还有竖纹吗？这是最简单的肾阳虚面相。亏你还说自己是学医的，真是丢人现眼。”
没想到这个土包子竟然还有一点医术，估计是瞎猫碰到死耗子。
李向阳自忖是对方说中了自己心事，不过，却也不愿意在陆檀香面前丢人，当下不再多说，低头绕过杨云帆，往陆檀香而去。
“四眼田鸡，我劝你最好少看那些淫秽的东西，也少想那些龌龊的事情。不然，等到你腰膝酸冷，脘腹畏寒，形寒肢冷，四肢不温的时候，那就倒了大霉了。”
那李向阳充耳不闻，哼了一声，回头瞪着杨云帆，色厉内荏道：“你这个臭土鳖，危言耸听，还不滚开！你身上那么臭，都快把人给熏死了！檀香现在呼吸都困难了，看来是需要做人工呼吸了。你这土鳖说话这么臭，一定有口臭。所以，这人工呼吸，还是我来做吧。”
说完，他洋洋得意，哈了几口气，正准备凑到陆檀香旁边去。
陆檀香这会儿懒得理会李向阳这个癞蛤蟆，用最后的力气一把将他推开，反而不断的哀求杨云帆道：“小哥，你再帮我捏几下吧？”
“什么？再捏几下？你要他捏你什么？你，你们……”那男青年听到这话，脸色顿时变得涨红无比！

他从高中开始就追求这个陆檀香，一直追求到大学。还死皮赖脸的跟她报考同一所学校，就是为了近水楼台先得月。谁知道自己只不过跟陆檀香分开了几个小时，就让人趁虚而入了！
一瞬间，他像是一只鼓胀起来的癞蛤蟆一样，两颊气呼呼的，瞪着杨云帆：“小子，我看你敢动一下！”
“檀香，等我一会儿！”说完，那个李向阳赶紧跑了出去。
不到一分钟，他又满头大汗的跑回来了。
只见他献宝似的拿出了一包止疼药，递给陆檀香：“檀香，吃了这个止疼药，半个小时就起效了。”
杨云帆看了一眼，原来是“布洛芬缓释胶囊”。
看到这个药，他简直要晕倒了。
一个大男人，竟然随身带着一包痛经吃的止疼药，简直让人无言以对。
只是，陆檀香看了一眼那个止疼药，脸色更加难看了，斥道：“我对这个药物过敏。吃了会更痛！李向阳，你是不是想痛死我？”
骂了几句，陆檀香又哎呦哎呦的捂着肚子，双腿交缠着，看来是痛的难受极了。
“那可怎么办啊？”
李向阳假装焦急。
而后，他扶了一下眼镜，忽然间，眼睛微微一眯，猥琐无比道：“要不，还是让我给你揉揉肚子吧。我的手法很好的，帮你揉了肚子，保证你很快就不痛了。”
“滚开吧，你！”

That Li Xiangyang took three steps at a time, walked up to Yang Yunfan, and said sarcastically: "Did you, a brat, bring some unclean food to Sandalwood? Looking at the sloppy clothes you wore, there might be some virus in what you ate. Of course you will get a stomachache if you eat unclean things."
Li Xiangyang originally thought that Yang Yunfan looked like a country bumpkin and was easily bullied, but he knew that he was completely wrong.
As soon as he finished speaking, Yang Yunfan stood up suddenly.
"What did you say? You four-eyed frog, just keep talking and retract your dog's paws!" Yang Yunfan is tall, over 1.8 meters tall, and Li Xiangyang is as skinny as a drug addict. As soon as Yang Yunfan stood up, he felt a little weak.
"I, I don't have the same experience as you!"
Li Xiangyang gave Yang Yunfan a stern look, then looked at Lu Tanxiang, changing the subject and said: "Sanxiang, let me see your belly, I am from the Department of Medicine of Xiangtan University."
As he spoke, Li Xiangyang carefully walked around Yang Yunfan and came to Lu Tanxiang, making a gesture to reach out to Lu Tanxiang's belly.
"Haha, you four-eyed frog is really interesting. Give you a rope and you will climb along the pole."
As soon as Yang Yunfan saw him like this, he knew that he would take the opportunity to eat tofu. He did not give him any face, and said sarcastically: "However, I advise you not to take her idea. I see that your limbs are weak, the bags under your eyes are blue, and there are inexplicable vertical lines on your forehead. You must be suffering from kidney deficiency. I guess you have a stomachache at five o'clock every day. Do you get up and have diarrhea?"
"You, how did you know?" When Li Xiangyang heard this, his expression suddenly changed.
How did this bumpkin know about such a secret thing? He didn't tell anyone about this. He suffered from kidney deficiency at a young age. He would not tell anyone about such a shameful thing.
"How do I know?"
Yang Yunfan sneered and said: "Don't you know that your face is blue and dull, and there are vertical lines on your forehead? This is the simplest sign of kidney yang deficiency. It's really embarrassing for you to say that you are studying medicine."
I didn't expect this country bumpkin to have some medical skills. He was probably a blind cat who met a dead mouse.
Li Xiangyang thought that the other party had told what was on his mind, but he was unwilling to embarrass himself in front of Lu Tanxiang. He said no more at the moment, lowered his head and walked around Yang Yunfan towards Lu Tanxiang.
"Four-eyed Frog, I advise you to read less obscene things and think less about dirty things. Otherwise, you will be in serious trouble when your waist and knees are sore, your stomach and abdomen are cold, your body is cold and your limbs are cold, and your limbs are not warm."
Li Xiangyang turned a deaf ear, snorted, turned back and glared at Yang Yunfan, and said with a stern look: "You stinky country bumpkin, you are an alarmist, why don't you get out of here! You are so smelly, it almost kills people! Sandalwood has difficulty breathing now, it seems that artificial respiration is needed. You country bumpkin talks so stinky, you must have bad breath. So, I'll do the artificial respiration."
After saying that, he felt proud, let out a few breaths, and was about to move next to Lu Tanxiang.
Lu Tanxiang was too lazy to pay attention to the toad Li Xiangyang at the moment, and used her last strength to push him away. Instead, she kept begging Yang Yunfan: "Brother, can you squeeze him a few more times?"
"What? How many more pinches? Why do you want him to pinch you? You, you..." When the young man heard this, his face suddenly turned red!
He has been pursuing Lu Tanxiang since high school and has been pursuing her until college. He even shamelessly applied for the same school as her, just to get the first-come-first-served. Who knew that he and Lu Tanxiang had only been separated for a few hours, and someone would take advantage of them!
For a moment, he was like a swollen toad, his cheeks were filled with anger, and he stared at Yang Yunfan: "Boy, I think you dare to move!"
"Sanxiang, wait for me for a moment!" After saying that, Li Xiangyang ran out quickly.
In less than a minute, he ran back again, sweating profusely.
He took out a pack of painkillers as if offering a treasure and handed them to Lu Tanxiang: "Sanxiang, take this painkiller and it will take effect in half an hour."
Yang Yunfan took a look and saw that it was "ibuprofen sustained-release capsules."
Seeing this medicine, he almost fainted.
A grown man actually carries a pack of painkillers for menstrual cramps with him, which makes people speechless.
However, Lu Tanxiang glanced at the painkiller, her face became even more ugly, and she scolded: "I'm allergic to this medicine. It will hurt even more if I take it! Li Xiangyang, do you want to hurt me to death?"
After a few curses, Lu Tanxiang clutched her stomach and tangled her legs. It seemed that she was in excruciating pain.
"What should I do?"
Li Xiangyang pretended to be anxious.
Then, he adjusted his glasses, and suddenly, his eyes narrowed slightly, and he said in a very vulgar manner: "How about you let me rub your belly. My technique is very good, I will rub your belly for you, and I will ensure that you will stop feeling pain soon."
"Go away, you!"
